categories.main_business_segments: Boryung Corporation primarily operates in pharmaceutical manufacturing and sales, focusing on prescription drugs, over-the-counter (OTC) medicines, raw materials, and contract manufacturing. Key therapeutic areas include hypertension, dyslipidemia, diabetes, central nervous system (CNS) disorders, oncology, renal diseases, and specialty care such as acute and hospital medicines. The company also engages in export, real estate leasing, and clinical service businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing capabilities including a multi-product capable plant in Ansan and a modular smart factory in Yesan, certified with EU-GMP standards. It emphasizes in-house drug development, especially with its proprietary new drug Kanarb (fimasartan), and employs innovative R&D processes with dedicated research centers focusing on new chemical entities, improved formulations, and biosimilars. The production system integrates automated and self-operating equipment for efficient, high-quality pharmaceutical manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Boryung serves hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and wholesalers domestically, with a strong focus on chronic disease treatment markets such as hypertension, diabetes, oncology, and CNS disorders. It also targets international markets through licensing and export agreements in regions including Latin America, Southeast Asia, Africa, and China. The company’s customer base includes healthcare providers and patients requiring both prescription and OTC medications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with nationwide sales coverage through 10 domestic sales branches. It has international licensing and export agreements covering Latin America (Mexico, Central and South American countries), Southeast Asia (Thailand, Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore), Africa (South Africa and neighboring countries), and China. Manufacturing facilities are located in Ansan and Yesan, South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: Boryung operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, including drug development, manufacturing, and distribution. It produces finished pharmaceutical products in-house and sells directly to healthcare providers and distributors, while also engaging in licensing out products internationally. The company’s supply chain includes raw material procurement, in-house production, and sales to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus centers on strengthening proprietary product capabilities and building a stable portfolio focused on chronic diseases. R&D priorities include developing innovative new drugs, improved formulations, and first-generation generics, with active clinical trials in hypertension, diabetes, oncology, CNS, and renal diseases. The company pursues Legacy Brands Acquisition (LBA) to incorporate established off-patent drugs, enhancing market presence and profitability. It also invests in digital transformation and compliance to support global competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of prescription and OTC pharmaceuticals, both domestically and internationally. The company also earns licensing fees and supply contract revenues from international partners. Additional income streams include contract manufacturing, clinical service fees, and real estate leasing. Sales are recognized upon product shipment or delivery, and licensing revenues follow IFRS 15 standards.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Boryung is positioned as a mid-to-large pharmaceutical company in South Korea, competing with major domestic firms such as Yuhan, Green Cross, Chong Kun Dang, Daewoong, Hanmi, and Dong-A ST. It holds a significant market share in chronic disease segments, especially hypertension and oncology, with a growing presence in diabetes and CNS markets. The company leverages proprietary drugs and LBA strategy to differentiate itself in a competitive and polarized domestic pharmaceutical industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Boryung reported consolidated revenues of approximately 859.6 billion KRW, reflecting a 13% year-over-year growth, and operating profit of 68.3 billion KRW, up 21%. The company’s total assets stand at about 915.5 billion KRW with a solid equity ratio of 60%. It has demonstrated consistent growth driven by proprietary product expansion and portfolio diversification, achieving record-high financial performance in its history.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Boryung emphasizes its strong proprietary product portfolio, especially the Kanarb family, which is a leading domestic new drug in hypertension treatment. The company differentiates through high-quality manufacturing capabilities, robust R&D pipeline, and strategic acquisition of Legacy Brands that maintain stable market shares post-patent expiry. Its integrated approach combining innovation, manufacturing excellence, and marketing strength ensures sustainable growth and competitive advantage in chronic disease markets.
